scope.text:
Scope bar and breadcrumb are dynamic, built from where the user is:

Near me · [state / prefecture] · [country] · World

Kochi: Near me · Kerala · India · World
Kyoto: Near me · Kyoto · Japan · World
Paris: Near me · Île-de-France · France · World

Comes from reverse geocoding (locality → district → state → country). If a country has no useful state level (e.g. Singapore), that tab is skipped. Section titles follow too: "Legends of Kerala" becomes "Legends of Kyoto".
